title: Fresh Corn, Peach, Avocado & Goat Cheese Salad with Garlic Breadsticks

steps.text: Peel and mince garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the garlic oil.

Drizzle garlic oil over the flatbreads, cut into 1½-inch wide strips, and transfer to a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Remove husks and silks from the corn. Using a knife, carefully slice corn kernels off the cobs; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist to separate and remove pit. Medium dice and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Peel and small dice onion. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl and gently stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and breadsticks between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
